policy.name: reviewed_native_v3
policy.mit_capacity: Native QDischarge is primary. Integral disagreement alone is a review note, not label rejection. Summary/counter agreement is not an independent physical calibration.
policy.mit_trace: Aggregate discharge fragments; detect intervening charge and counter reset across gaps. Integrate only observed within-run intervals; never integrate long sampling gaps.
policy.other_datasets: NASA absent-charge-log review policy; CALCE and XJTU raw-QC exclusions retained.
policy.context: 64 original consecutive record positions. Rejected measurements are NaN inputs; target must be eligible. At least two finite inputs for the linear baseline. No filling or row compression.
policy.uncertainty: MIT CV export/current-counter mismatch unresolved; native capacity retained under an explicit measurement-source policy. CALCE unknown physical cycles between files remain unknown.
